notes.title: Developer Update #2: Upgrades!
notes.content:
[b]Welcome[/b]
Hi! I am Jordy, the developer of Rogue Tank.

This is the second developer update. I figured that other than just giving a quick progress update, I could tell you about some of the features of Rogue Tank. For this update, I’ll talk about…
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43472555/8f27399bc7c9e06c9d9a08dbb9489b7ff290f389.jpg[/img]

[b]So, upgrades, what do they do?[/b]
Well, upgrades up-grade your tank. Obviously. Maybe you want to deal extra damage at long range! Maybe, you want enemies to explode into a rain of burning projectiles as they explode! Or maybe you just want to move fast! As of writing, there are 33 various upgrades to pick from! However, you only get to pick from 3 randomly chosen upgrades each time you level-up. Some upgrades will always be available to you, while others might be specific to your primary or secondary weapon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43472555/fd5ed73e28747604ad4a546585233e5551f77f08.png[/img]

[b]Combine and Conquer[/b]
Upgrades are good on their own, but get a lot stronger when combined! Carefully pick and choose the right set of upgrades to absolutely destroy your enemies. Maybe you go all in with critical strikes and electric damage! One of my personal favorite combinations is “Blacksmith” and “Molten Armor”; set enemies on fire by ramming them, and then deal a ton of bonus damage to enemies on fire!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43472555/d9e832773861b29d5b176bd1be9fe86d29128eda.gif[/img]

[b]What have I been working on?[/b]
First of all, I gathered a bunch of feedback from the Steam Next Fest! Thank you to everyone trying out the demo! I’m actively working towards improving the game based on this feedback. There is also new content in the works at the moment. I’ve been focused on concepting and prototyping new environments to play in. Here’s a little sneak peek of a (potential) new environment prototype.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43472555/76a49363bcdc9f95eda5a49a6522768a1c126c89.png[/img]

Thank you for reading this update! Are there any upgrades you want to see in the game? Let me know in the comments!

notes.title: Developer Update #1: Welcome!
notes.content:
[b]Welcome[/b]
Hi! I am Jordy, the developer of Rogue Tank.

Rogue Tank is a solo developer project. I started working on Rogue Tank over a year ago now and a lot has changed since then. Initially the project's scope was a lot smaller. What is currently the demo, was intended to be the full experience. A little project that would serve as a piece for my portfolio, but not much more than that. But thanks to positive feedback, I decided to continue working on it and turning it into a full release game. So, that's what I am doing now! In this update you will find some of the work in progress. But first...

[b]Steam Next Fest[/b]
June 10th to 17th, the Steam Next Fest takes place, and Rogue Tank will be participating with the demo, yay! In the demo players are able to play the first map: City Showdown, using the classic rocket launcher and gatling gun weapons. A subset of the upgrades is available that will allow for multiple builds and shenanigans. However, players can not unlock any of the additional content through the garage. As of this week, I am making some small adjustment to the demo to get it ready for next fest. A few minor bugs have been fixed and additional feedback is being implemented.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43472555/b32eff71cb4d7bdd10cf05969b408f609c00a46e.png[/img]

[b]Work in Progress[/b]
I love the classic rocket launcher and gatling gun combo, but there are 3 additional primary and 3 secondary weapons in further stages of development (and more to come). You will be able to mix and match those weapons to your preferred playstyle! Whether you like to fight up close with a shotgun, or want to burn them to a crisp with a flame cannon, is up to you! My favorite weapon combo right now is all about burning enemies. Once you start stacking that burn damage, the enemies are done for.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/w5UEGWB.gif[/img]

[b]Your feedback is important![/b]
Additionally, I am concepting and developing more enemies, maps and upgrades. Content is steadily being created and refined. However, good content is never created without players' feedback, therefore I am (secretly) launching a Discord server: [url=https://discord.gg/Zpza3BHR]Join here![/url] You can join the Discord if you are interested in: helping me test and improve new features, naming weapons and enemies, giving me your cool game ideas, or have any questions about further development!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43472555/86673ee2c68ec754f0e7f82fc320c9e1aee6f27c.png[/img]

[b]That's all for the first update! [/b]
Thank you for reading, and if you haven't tried the demo, give it a shot! I will be back with a new update after the Steam Next Fest. Bye-Bye!
